name: apiosk-mcp
description: Ask a data question, review one plan and total price ceiling, approve in the chat card within your connected account's spending limits, and receive source-backed results. Resume without buying the same work twice.
author: Apiosk

tools.name: apiosk_sources
tools.description: Browse published data sources by name, category, sector, tag or capability. Free and paginated; creates no task and buys nothing.

tools.name: apiosk_ask
tools.description: Find sources, refresh a signed search, prepare selected sources or a complete plan, and continue questions using saved evidence. Review one total price before manual approval.

tools.name: apiosk_external
tools.description: Inspect a Bazaar source, prepare its quote without buying, and read saved purchase results.

tools.name: apiosk_external_approve
tools.description: App-only: approve the exact saved Bazaar quote after the person clicks Approve. Never invoked by the model.

tools.name: apiosk_discover
tools.description: Plan a new data question across several sources: one plan, one total price ceiling or the clarification it needs. Nothing is bought until the person approves.

tools.name: apiosk_execute
tools.description: Continue a task with a returned next_action: supply input, select an entity, run an approved step or cancel. Paid steps require the saved approval and current quote.

tools.name: apiosk_status
tools.description: Read a task's saved results, actual charges and status. Free and read-only; never approves or buys.

tools.name: apiosk_approve
tools.description: App-only: called by the interactive card when the person clicks Approve, within the connection's spending limits. Never invoked by the model.

tools.name: apiosk_requote
tools.description: App-only: called by the interactive card to refresh an expired saved quote for the exact selected sources. Never approves spending, calls paid sources or starts execution.
